_README: Amazon Associates config for Healthy Faith Daily, same approach as HealthyOne (HardawayLabs/affiliate_products.json). scripts/blog_publish.py picks up to 3 products per post by keyword match (or the post JSON's optional "affiliate": [search, ...] list) and renders them below the app CTA with the disclosure. SEARCH links on purpose so discontinued products never 404. Only products listed here are used; never invent queries or tags. Items marked popular:true were on Amazon's Christian Books & Bibles best-seller lists when added (2026-11-10).
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, Healthy Faith Daily (Hardaway Labs) earns from qualifying purchases. These links may earn us a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only suggest things we think are useful for reading and studying the Bible.
